title: PNJ TIK Department Launches New Cybersecurity Lab
summary: To support the study programs, the TIK department has officially opened a state-of-the-art cybersecurity laboratory.
content:
Empowering the Next Generation of Security Experts

In response to the increasing demand for cybersecurity professionals, the Department of Teknik Informatika dan Komputer (TIK) has launched a new state-of-the-art security laboratory. This lab is fully equipped with advanced hardware and simulated cloud environments to facilitate hands-on learning in penetration testing, threat hunting, and digital forensics.

Students from the Rekayasa Keamanan Siber (RKS) study program will be the primary users of this space, gaining real-world skills through interactive cyber-range simulations.
author: Admin

title: Student Achievement: Gold Medal at National Web Programming Competition
summary: A team of students from the Teknik Informatika study program won gold in a rigorous web application development contest.
content:
Winning Gold on the National Stage

Our students have made us proud again! A team comprising of three brilliant minds from the Teknik Informatika (TI) study program achieved first place at the annual National Web Programming Contest.

Their project, a local community gear-sharing and booking app, stood out due to its clean code architecture, visually spectacular glassmorphic design, and highly responsive user experience. Congratulations to the team!
author: Admin
